items.title: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable turn robot arms into slapstick killer robots in new safety benchmark
items.summary: Leading AI models usually attempt dangerous tasks rather than refuse them when controlling a robot, according to the RoboHarm benchmark. GPT-6 Astra stabbed a baby doll in 17 of 20 trials, while Claude Fable 5.1 put a can of compressed air on a burning stove. None of the three models tested reliably rejected unsafe commands....

items.title: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash undercuts Google's Gemini Flash pricing while matching its multimodal benchmarks
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash is Qwen's first multimodal model designed for AI agents. It processes audio and video together and independently uses tools to edit vlogs, translate clips, or summarize movies. On audio-video benchmarks, it nearly matches Gemini 3.8 Flash at a fraction of the API cost....

items.title: OpenAI Introduces Triage Framework and Case Studies to Report Model Misalignment
items.summary: OpenAI has released a disclosure framework for model misalignment during its lifecycle. Employees can flag potential issues, prompting technical staff to label incidents. The initial case studies outline unexpected model behaviours, providing insights into deviations from expected parameters. Community reactions show both approval and scepticism regarding transparency and corporate narratives. By Olimpiu Pop

items.title: Trump announces "AI Force" and plans for an "AI czar" as he pushes unchecked AI growth
items.summary: Trump announces an "AI Force" modeled after the Space Force and plans to appoint an "AI czar" with a "high IQ." He claims AI could reach 25 percent of US economic output, rejects new regulation, and frames criticism of data centers as a left-wing attack. items.summary: OpenAI introduces the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a six-pillar roadmap for safer AI experiences that protect and empower young people.

items.title: WSO2 Releases Agent Manager as Enterprises Look to Control Growing AI Agent Sprawl
items.summary: WSO2 has announced the general availability of WSO2 Agent Manager, an open-source platform designed to provide centralized governance, identity management, security controls, and operational oversight for AI agents running across different models, frameworks, and deployment environments. By Craig Risi
